steps.en: Install the full Python package set
steps.zh: 安装完整 Python 包组合

steps.en: Write policy rules and register the wrapped tool instead of the original
steps.zh: 写策略规则，注册包装后的工具而非原函数

steps.en: Call the wrapped tool with the policy's action context
steps.zh: 带着策略所需动作上下文调用包装工具

steps.en: Evaluate policy and record the decision before tool execution
steps.zh: 在工具执行前评估策略并记录决定

steps.en: Reject forbidden calls or invoke the permitted tool
steps.zh: 拒绝违规调用，或执行被允许的工具

value.en: Tool execution follows explicit application policy rather than prompt-only requests
value.zh: 工具执行服从明确的应用策略，不只靠提示词请求
